defects.observed: Artifact SBOM tab attempted unsupported /api/v1/artifacts/{id}/sbom and /sbom/attestation requests from the browser.
defects.resolution: Artifact route now derives SBOM display data from artifact projection fields and e2e tests fail if those unsupported endpoints are requested.

defects.observed: Artifact overview and detail UI allowed duplicate version/name, inconsistent value sizes, unknown version icon, and overflowing IDs.
defects.resolution: Artifact route now derives distinct display name/version values, uses a file icon for version, and constrains wrapping/clipping.

defects.observed: High-visibility artifact/auth/DNS labels exposed implementation terminology.
defects.resolution: Visible strings in touched routes/components now use product-level wording; deeper admin settings cleanup is tracked separately.
